items.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announces $2B in new AI deals during Europe tour
items.why: Signals accelerating Nvidia enterprise/sovereign AI deal flow in Europe, supporting GPU demand outlook

items.headline: China lets provinces draw on $82B (550bn yuan) in unspent bond quota to shore up growth
items.why: Added fiscal stimulus signals Beijing growth concerns, shaping China macro and risk appetite for AI/tech equities

items.headline: OpenAI ARR: Axios (9/29) reported ~$70B; Bloomberg/FT (10/8) say investors told ~$50B at Sept-end, $70B+ targeted by year-end
items.why: Gap between scoop and investor-told figure raises growth/accounting credibility questions ahead of heavy compute spend

items.headline: Fed minutes show unanimous Sept 25bp hike to 3.75%-4.00%, but deep split on further hikes
items.why: First Fed hike since 2023; most participants leaned toward another hike by year-end, key for rate-sensitive AI/tech valuations

items.headline: DeepSeek nears $12B+ funding round backed by Tencent and CATL ahead of 2027 IPO
items.why: Major capital infusion for China's leading open AI lab, intensifying US-China AI competition and compute buildout

items.headline: AI cloud/GPU neocloud Lambda raising up to $4B at $14.5B pre-money valuation ahead of planned 2027 IPO
items.why: Signals continued investor appetite for GPU-cloud neoclouds amid hyperscaler AI capex boom; adds to IPO pipeline

items.headline: Nvidia faces scrutiny over China AI chip smuggling cases amid US export-control enforcement
items.why: Highlights ongoing leakage of restricted AI chips to China and enforcement risk for Nvidia's China exposure
